isomorphisms.name: Privatio Boni as Structural Parasitism
isomorphisms.chi_law: Evil is a privation of due good; a defect has no independent substance but is a failure of proper function.
isomorphisms.theological_phenomenon: Evil as parasitic on good; evil acts defined by the good they violate.
isomorphisms.prediction: Any coherent definition of evil will reference a prior good.
mapped_text_steps: Evil acts defined by good they violate
preserved_transitions: From evil act to violated good
missing_transitions: No mapping to physical dynamics of emergence
isomorphisms.notes: Strong logical mapping but lacks a physical process; it's a metaphysical claim with formal structure.

isomorphisms.name: Information-Theoretic Ground State
isomorphisms.chi_law: A deceptive ground state maximizes entropy (noise); a truthful ground state enables low-entropy structure.
isomorphisms.physics_process: Shannon channel capacity: signal-to-noise ratio determines information transmission; high noise collapses capacity.
isomorphisms.theological_phenomenon: A lying foundation would produce maximal noise, preventing stable laws; observed low-entropy universe implies truthful ground.
isomorphisms.prediction: If the ground were deceptive, physical laws would be unstable or non-repeatable.
isomorphisms.notes: Excellent mapping; the entropy argument is precise and testable.

isomorphisms.name: Byzantine Generals Coordination
isomorphisms.chi_law: Coordinated action requires honest signals; physical constants coordinate with precision beyond probability, proving clean ground signal.
isomorphisms.physics_process: Byzantine Generals: >2/3 honest generals needed for consensus; traitors cause system collapse.
isomorphisms.theological_phenomenon: Physical constants coordinate to produce stable universe; if ground were deceptive, coordination would fail.
isomorphisms.prediction: If ground were deceptive, fine-tuning would be impossible.
physics_process_steps: System collapses if too many traitors
missing_transitions: Exact threshold (2/3) not mapped to specific constant ratios
isomorphisms.notes: Strong analogy but the mapping of threshold is not precise; still a compelling structural claim.

isomorphisms.name: Evil-God Challenge Asymmetry
isomorphisms.chi_law: Evil-God is dependent on creation (needs victims), subordinate to prior standard of good, and cannot explain observed goods (oxytocin, music, etc.).
isomorphisms.theological_phenomenon: Symmetry between good-God and evil-God arguments breaks on dependency, subordination, and explanatory failure.
isomorphisms.prediction: An evil-God cannot explain altruistic or beautiful phenomena.
isomorphisms.notes: Logical asymmetry is well-argued but not a physical isomorphism; it's a philosophical disanalogy.

isomorphisms.name: Truth Signature as Structural Properties
isomorphisms.chi_law: Truth has signature properties (consistent, eternal, unchanging, universal, ordered, generative, beautiful); universe exhibits all.
isomorphisms.theological_phenomenon: The universe's properties (stability, universality, beauty) are signatures of a truthful foundation.
missing_transitions: No mapping from truth properties to physical mechanisms
isomorphisms.notes: More of a list of attributes than a structural mapping; lacks process-level correspondence.
